question: How long does the Samsung Galaxy S10 last between charges in everyday use?
answer:
One reviewer reported that the Galaxy S10's battery life lasts about one day and needs to be charged nightly. [8b615d3582a4_0]
Another reviewer said the battery was around 50% after a full day of use. [d29dc50a732a_0]
One reviewer described the battery life as excellent for a renewed item. [8c3039188ccf_0]
A different reviewer said the battery only lasts a couple of hours, even when not actively using the phone. [2e629a5210ff_0]
One reviewer reported that the phone came charged at 75% and was dead within a couple of hours. [a04d016a168b_0]
Another reviewer stated that the battery does not last as long as their previous S10. [7c4e3402264e_0]

chunks.text: S10 is for moms. Tiny screen, tiny battery life. Luckily some bloatware can be uninstalled via adb, even without root. Search xda for details. Battery life - 1 day, need to charge nightly. Compared to my other Samsung A70 with its 6.7" screen and 3 day battery life - abysmal.
As described. Battery does not last as long as previous s10. As described. Battery does not last as long as previous s10

No bueno.. Although we did receive the s10, the battery life was terrible. It came charged at 75%, within a couple hours it was dead and would take almost a full week plugged in to charge to 100%. We were not offered a replacement, however, the phone was sent back and we were given a full refund.

Battery life is terrible.. Very poor battery life. I've bought another S10 renewed and it didn't have this massive battery drain. It only lasts a couple of hours, even if you're not actively using it.

Basically Brand New. If you read the description you'll see that it only comes with a charger. The S10+ I got looks brand new. I could not find any scratches, any finger prints, or any imperfections at all. The model is SM-G975U1 and it came with android 10.

Excellent value. The S10 was in almost new condition, had to look close to see any sign of use. I've had it a little over a week, everything works as it should, the battery is around 50% after a full day of use. Highly recommended.
Renewed S10 Good. S10 has met all my needs. Excellent battery life for a renewed item.

7 days. So far, not so good after a promising start. Update: Phone refuses to hold APN data resulting in being unable to send or receive attachments via text. Had the exact same issue with an S9 about 6 months ago. Unfortunately, that's a deal breaker and I'll have to return. Not desuaded - I'll get another s10 for her. I bought two AT&T Galaxy S10's "renewed" for use on Consumer Cellular. This one for my wife who had a Galaxy S7. I haven't used a Samsung in decades but since I was doing the set-up and transfers, I'll make comment only on those items she's commented on. She was upset that certain items DID NOT transfer to her newer Samsung, that may have been on me but, I'll let them take the heat for now.

The S10 5G 256gb was a Sprint Unlocked and the had an old battery with 502 Discharge Cycles. Old battery that was heavily used, after 500 Discharge Cycles, battery must be replaced, this phone had 502 Discarge Cycles
S10 dies exactly a year later. The phone just died a year later; in addition to the very bad app UI. as well as its camera.
